paraphrase: Rival to STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-OF-CATHOLIC-CHURCH: for any being g from which Jesus holds a mandate, and any society c, Jesus did not found c in the exercise of that mandate. Its intended gloss, not encoded in the Lean type, is that the mandate is a commission to proclaim a message (the Gospel). It does not deny that Jesus holds a mandate, and it does not by itself deny that Jesus founded a society (that is the stage-5 rival).
